mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression codec

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This policy will be updated once a decision is made and recorded.

cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The Muninn catalog has no compression entry, and `muninn why` came back "insufficient". Its closest hits were unrelated episodes (msgpack, TLS and hashing choices). Msgpack is a serialization format, not a compression codec.

Muninn also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That means a hook is exceeding its timeout, and memory retrieval may be incomplete. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
